units.label: 全量数学变式鲁棒性
units.description: 25既有模型原题/八类变式的准确率、PDR、ASP及七类敏感性分析。

units.label: 母题变式配对转移
units.description: 按每母题八对统计四类正确性转移，不是训练迁移干预。

units.label: 四提示对照子实验
units.description: 随机120母题+960变式，4模型4提示但示例预算不等。

units.label: COMP自反馈与集成
units.description: GPT3.5子目标/参考计算、自检/终止及SC组合的子样本实验。

units.label: 材料生成/人工修订
units.description: GPT4生成题及答案、5人资格与质量核查、交叉标注及偏好检查，支撑正式任务。

units.label: 人类答题参照
units.description: 3人众包、随机50母题+400变式；不是全库或同5名材料标注者。

facts.statement: GSM-Plus按Polya解题阶段构造小学数学推理鲁棒性测量，关心模型能否随数值/条件/问题目标变化正确响应；并非只报一个benchmark总分。

method_function.text: 理论启发→五个视角八类变式→原题/变式行为配对链清楚；不能将其任务得分自动等同广义理解或批判思维能力。

facts.statement: 以GSM8K test的1319原题为母题，每题各8变式得到10552变式；原题另保留，八个配对共享同一母题。

method_function.text: 样本为题/母题族嵌套，不是10552互不相关原题；无条件将其当独立观测会影响稳健性统计。

facts.statement: 数值三变式：同位数数值替换、增加位数、整数/小数/分数转换；尽量少改文字并保留问题有效性。

method_function.text: 三种数值扰动分别编码，IDF可改变具体数值而非仅相同数的格式；表2 three→1/4与2→2.5说明此边界。

facts.statement: 算术两变式：添加条件以增加四则运算步骤；逆向将原答案变已知，原已知量变查询目标，避免额外约束并形成不同答案。

method_function.text: 实际算术/目标操纵不属于语义等价prompt改写，不能把所有八变式都要求答案不变。

facts.statement: 另外三类：Problem Understanding等义换措辞/句式且解不变；Distractor Insertion加主题相关但答案无关、最好含数字的条件且解不变；Critical Thinking删必要条件使题无确定答案。

method_function.text: 区分应保持答案与应改变/拒答的有效性标准；critical thinking在此操作化为识别信息不足，非任意怀疑。

facts.statement: GPT-4据扰动名称/说明、母题及原答案rationale生成最少编辑的变式，再另提示解答并输出####数值；生成提示要求唯一数值答案与critical-thinking无有效答案存在模板张力。

method_function.text: 题目生成与解题两个调用角色分开；原答案供生成者而非正式被测模型；共同模板不能抹去删条件类别例外。

facts.statement: 全部GPT-4变式/答案由人工检查并修订不合规/额外改动/无效题/难度超标/错答案。5名本科以上标注者先24变式(3母题)资格测试及反馈，每批50母题，作者随机抽2母题并排核查。

method_function.text: 实际人工质量控制包含题与答案；资格、反馈和作者抽查不是正式人类表现测试。

facts.statement: 正文称约10%变式至少3人交叉、原始一致率90.02%、18.85%被修订；附录具体随机1000变式至少3人、作者裁定分歧，Krippendorff α=.567。

method_function.text: 原始一致率与机会校正α不同，不能把90.02%称α或互相覆盖；1000/10552约9.48%仅近似10%。编码单位/α距离设置未详报。

facts.statement: 人工判定GPT-4变式通过率按8类报告，逆向仅29.76%，措辞改写97.49%；题合规与答案正确分开核查。

method_function.text: 逆向低通过率指自动候选质量，不是最终库仅29.76%有效或模型解题准确率。

facts.statement: GPT-4在母题/自生成变式/人工修订变式准确率93.25/87.36/85.58，作者据两种变式表现近似认为生成偏好影响有限。

method_function.text: 这是作者实施的生成偏好比较，非随机匹配的难度/污染完全排除；不证明不存在偏好或训练泄漏。

facts.statement: 测25个现有LLM，分闭源GPT4/GPT3.5、Mistral/Llama2/CodeLlama基础模型、多个现成数学SFT checkpoint(7/13/70B)。输出可为NL、程序或两者；本研究比较这些既有模型，不自行SFT。

method_function.text: 模型规模、训练来源和输出协议是不同现有模型属性，不能从跨模型差异直接隔离微调因果效应。

facts.statement: 主评估温度0；开源base模型8个demonstrations，闭源和数学模型有各自输出格式。四prompt子实验随机120母题+960变式，选GPT4/GPT3.5/Llama2-70B/MAmmoTH70B。

method_function.text: 主全量、prompt子样本分开；prompt条件复杂度CoT8shot、LtM1shot并非等示例预算。

facts.statement: PDR=1−ACC(变式)/ACC(母题)，可为负表示改善；ASP为每个母题与各变式同时正确的指示乘积和，除N×|D|，N=8。

method_function.text: PDR是相对下降非百分点；ASP分母全部配对而非母题答对条件，不能当条件转移成功率或八变式全对率。

facts.statement: 配对输出分为原/变皆对、皆错、原对变错、原错变对四类，图3表示共享母题重复配对的行为转移。

method_function.text: 单对皆错不能证明普遍无推理能力；四格分布不等于训练/迁移干预，也非独立训练样本。

facts.statement: 对于删必要条件题，只要输出包含列举的任一信息不足/不能算/不知道/none等字符串就判正确。其他数值抽取/容差、程序执行失败与拒答解析未详述。

method_function.text: 实际关键词规则可能容许否定/部分叙述误命中；按已实施规则提取，不升级成语义正确性人工评分。

facts.statement: 人类表现基准随机50母题和400变式共450题，腾讯众包3名有1000以上HIT历史且本科以上的合格者，先9题资格考试并记录每答时间。

method_function.text: 3名人类解题者与5名材料标注者职责不同；未说明任务分配/跨人聚合/顺序平衡，450题不是模型全量10552。

facts.statement: 主表人类ACC96.77/98.75、PDR−2.05%、ASP92.11；GPT4为93.25/85.58、PDR8.23、ASP81.54。人类母题ACC96.77的分母/聚合无法由50题直接重建。

method_function.text: 描述来源值，不由表数补造人类答题N或直接同题可比效应。

facts.statement: 作者比较现有数学SFT/基础模型的准确率与PDR，报告更高准确率不一定更鲁棒；各扰动中删条件、增/逆运算和干扰较难，数值替换/措辞部分可改善。

method_function.text: 保留不同变化方向，未实施统计检验不能把significantly文字当推断性检验；不把训练数据属性解释自动当因果控制。

facts.statement: 附录另去掉critical-thinking，仅7变式重算准确率/PDR/ASP，与8类结果并列；Table8若干母题ACC与Table4不同，如MetaMath-Mistral77.79/78.01、MetaMath70B82.11/82.41未解释。

method_function.text: 这是类别集合敏感性分析，7类不是新独立样本；母题数值版本差异原样保留。

facts.statement: 四种提示包括CoT、PoT、Least-to-Most子问题分解和复杂度CoT(较多步骤示例)；子实验显示没有一种消除全部扰动下差距。

method_function.text: PoT含程序/外部解释器的一般方法描述，具体运行环境未给；不把COMP的自然语言自检误写成执行Python。

facts.statement: COMP先提取数字相关关键premises并编号；然后按原题和premises迭代生成subgoal及参考计算，后续输入包含此前subgoals/calculations。

method_function.text: 模型生成的premises为辅助上下文，不是已验证外部事实或检索；区分首次与后续history输入。

facts.statement: COMP的计算提示提供当前subgoal及模型参考计算，要求审查，有强烈错误判断则解释重生，否则Pass；首步/后续各有模板，后续还传完整既往thoughts。

method_function.text: 实际是自然语言自反馈纠错，不是有数值oracle/工具执行的独立验证器；没有训练评分器。

facts.statement: 每步合并当前及以往子目标/计算，检查最后subgoal是否满足题目最后一句Queried Answer；答No继续，包含So the answer is则终止。最大步数/循环失败处理未报。

method_function.text: 终止依赖模型自报+字符串协议，不是外部真值判定；明确状态历史与路由，防止漏掉关键停止规则。

facts.statement: CoT+SC采5个预测作多数投票；COMP+SC称对同一subgoal/calculation的中间thought作边缘化，附录区别pass@1与ensemble。其逐步采样数、等价判定、tie/聚合细节未详述。

method_function.text: 普通末答多数投票与中间步骤聚合分开，不能把CoT的5次自动套给COMP每步。

facts.statement: GPT3.5子样本Table5 CoT/LtM/COMP/CoT+SC/COMP+SC在GSMPlus为62.92/62.60/65.52/66.88/69.47，母题74.17/74.17/76.67/76.67/80；所称比LtM提高3.4/4.7%是相对改善近似。

method_function.text: 对应差2.50/2.92个百分点，不能把相对百分比当百分点；不是25模型全量COMP结果。

facts.statement: 细分Table9 COMP在干扰62.50低于CoT63.33，但COMP+SC70.83较高；附录一般称COMP受重复尝试改善干扰须保留条件。质性Table10/11展示逆向/增运算中分解、计算和遗漏步骤实例。

method_function.text: 不由选出的案例推断全部链正确；保留负向/组合结果，而非写所有扰动均改善。

facts.statement: 生成模板统一要求唯一数值答案而删必要条件类别无有效答案；附录C.2原题写4点/25%却标Correct Answer的程序内改成6点/50%、输出15，与原题9不符。

method_function.text: 已视觉确认示例来源冲突，保留限制，不能默认为最终全部标签已错或自行修订数据。

facts.statement: 作者明确未评估整条solution chain正确性、未解释失败深层机制，其他教育阶段留未来。所给24页正文及A–C.8已读，仍未报checkpoint具体版本/硬件seed/程序沙箱/数值解析/统计CI、COMP重试上限与费用。

method_function.text: 当前是已核实未报告而不是漏读；无代码执行或外部API。方法事实可交接，不声称完整复现或用人类结果证明所有扰动难度不变。

most popularly used GSM8K dataset, yielding an
adversarial dataset for grade school math GSMP LUS. Motivated by the capability taxonomy for
solving math problems mentioned in Polya’s principles (Polya, 2004), we identify 5 perspectives
to guide the development of GSM-P LUS: (1) numerical variation refers to altering the numerical
data or its types (e.g., from integer to decimal).
(2) arithmetic variation refers to reversing or introducing additional operations, such as addition,
subtraction, multiplication, and division, to math
problems. (3) problem understanding refers to
rephrasing the text description of the math problems. (4) distractor insertion refers to inserting
topic-related but useless sentences to the problems.
(5) critical thinking focuses on question or doubt
ability when the question lacks necessary statements. Based on the 1,319 test questions from
GSM8K, we create eight variations for each question, the yielding GSM-P LUS comprises 10,552
question variations. By testing LLMs using each
question and its eight variations, GSM-P LUS can
facilitate the holistic evaluation of LLMs’ robustness in solving math word problems.

Mathematical problem-solving is a complex cognitive process that humans have developed (Baroody, 1987; Verschaffel et al., 1999, i.a.). Polya’s
principles (Polya, 2004) suggest that humans solve
mathematical problems generally in four stages: (1)
identifying variables and relevant context, (2) representing the problem’s structure and discovering a
potential pattern, (3) calculating an answer, and (4)
verifying the correctness, which are widely used in
mathematics education (Baroody, 1987; Carpenter
et al., 1989; Verschaffel et al., 1999, i.a.).
Motivated by Polya’s principles, we design eight
perturbation types for testing LLM’s mathematical reasoning capabilities. The definition of eight
perturbations is shown in Table 6.

Numerical variation tests whether LLMs have
been overfitted by altering the numerical data and
seeing the prediction behaviors. We define three
subcategories of numerical variation below:
• Numerical Substitution: replaces numerical
data with another number that has the same number
of digits, such as replacing “16” with “20”.
• Digit Expansion: increases the number of digits in a number, such as replacing “16” with “1600”.

• Integer-decimal-fraction Conversion: uses different representation types of numbers instead of
only integers, e.g., converting “2” into “2.5”.

Numerical Substitution

It involves changing some numerical data while minimizing alterations to the
textual aspects, ensuring the question’s validity remains intact.

Digit Expansion

It refers to the process of increasing the number of digits of some numerical
values while minimizing alterations to the textual aspects, ensuring the question’s validity remains intact.

Integer-decimal-fraction Conversion

It refers to the process of converting some integer numbers into decimal or
fractional representations while trying to keep the textual aspects unchanged,
ensuring that the validity of the question is maintained.

Arithmetic variation focuses on the models’ flexibility in applying arithmetic operations according
to the question requirements. We define two subcategories of arithmetic variation as below:
• Adding Operation: increases seed question’s
statements but restricts the operations in addition,
subtraction, multiplication, and division.
• Reversing Operation: transforms a statement
of the seed question into the queried answer in the
generated variation. For example, the statement
“$2 per fresh duck egg” in the seed question is
transformed into the question sentence “How much
does each duck egg cost?”.

Adding Operation

It involves adding extra statements to the original problems, thereby increasing the number of reasoning steps or operations required to solve the rewritten
question. The allowed operations are limited to addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

Reversing Operation

It refers to converting the required answer of the original question into a
known condition and transforming one known variable into the newly desired
answer while avoiding the introduction of additional constraints. As a result,
the rewritten question yields a distinct required answer compared to the
original solution.

Problem understanding rephrases the question
to investigate the potential impact of questionwording on the model’s understanding.
Distractor insertion introduces topic-related but
useless sentences with numbers to test models’ ability of statement evaluation.
Critical thinking requires that models can question or doubt during the process of mathematical
reasoning, rather than mindless sycophancy (Wei
et al., 2023a). This means that a model should explicitly specify this issue if an essential statement
is removed from the seed question.

Problem Understanding

It refers to transforming the original problem into a new problem that uses
different wording or different sentence structures but does not change the
solution of the original problem.

Distractor Insertion

involves introducing distracting conditions that have no impact on the final
answer. These introduced conditions should be relevant to the topic of the
original question and preferably include numerical values. However, the
rewritten problem must maintain an identical solution to that of the original
problem.

Critical Thinking

refers to eliminating a condition from the original question that is crucial for
solving it while keeping the rest of the content unchanged. The rewritten
problem should no longer have a valid answer, as it lacks the constraint that
was removed.

To ensure data quality, all question variations
and answers produced by GPT-4 are further refined
by human annotators through a rigorous process.
Annotators are first required to annotate 24 variations as a qualifying exam to ensure the accuracy
of their annotation. To further control annotation
quality, the annotators are assigned workloads in
batches, with each batch consisting of 50 seed questions. Prompt feedback is provided throughout the
annotation process. Specifically, 10% of the variations were cross-annotated by at least 3 annotators
with a high inter-annotation consistency rate of
90.02%, demonstrating the reliability of human revisions. Overall, human annotators revised 18.85%
of the variations produced by GPT-4, highlighting
the importance of human revision. Detailed statistics across perturbation types are presented in Table 7 of the Appendix. Details of human annotation
can be found in Appendix B.2.

Before participating in the evaluation of question

1. They are first pre-screened with a qualification
study, which involves reading an evaluation
guideline and annotating 24 variations for 3
GSM8K questions.
2. We individually review the submitted evaluations from the qualification study and provide

Ultimately, we selected 5 evaluators with at least
bachelor’s degrees to participate in dataset quality evaluation. Throughout the whole process, the
annotators are assigned workloads in batches with

and the authors verify the annotations for question
variations and their corresponding answers using

constant communication with evaluators to answer
any questions.
Qualified human evaluators are involved to ensure that the questions generated by GPT-4 are free
from the errors specified in §3.2. If there are any
errors in the question variations generated by GPT4, the annotators will compose a qualified one with

Least-to-most prompting (LT M (Zhou et al., 2022))
simplifies the problem-solving process by breaking
down a complex problem into a series of subproblems. Besides, complexity-based C OT (Fu et al.,
2022) uses examples with a greater number of steps
as in-context demonstrations and enhances LLMs’
reasoning capability. The above progress motivates
us to investigate whether employing a prompting
method can help LLM attain comparable performance on both seed questions from GSM8K and
their eight variations from GSM-P LUS.
Which prompts are more robust? We select
four representative LLMs: GPT-4 and GPT-3.5Turbo as the highest-performing instruction-tuned
models, LLaMA-2-70B as the best open-source
general model, and MAmmoTH-70B as an SFTmodel fine-tuned on LLaMA-2-70B. Then we randomly select a subset of 120 seed questions and 960
variations to evaluate the performance of different
prompting methods when applied to these LLMs.
Results are shown in Figure 4. Overall, complexitybased C OT shows superior performance for GPT-4,
GPT-3.5-Turbo, and LLaMA-2-70B, while P OT exhibits the least effectiveness across all question variations. C OT and LT M exhibit similar patterns, excelling in variations such as problem understanding
and numerical substitution, but performing poorly
on distractor insertion and adding operation. For
MAmmoTH, the performance of the four prompts
is similar due to the task-specific training. None of
the studied prompting techniques are sufficiently robust to attain consistent performance across all variations comparable to the performance on GSM8K.

Limitations
The limitations of our work are as follows.
• In this work, we mainly focus on the robustness of math reasoning at the elementary school level, given the promising results
achieved by various LLMs, including opensourced models. Evaluating the robustness of
math reasoning at other levels of education is
left as future work.
• To assess robustness, we compare the answer accuracy of models on both GSM8K and
GSM-P LUS, along with the utilization of two
customized metrics. However, we do not investigate the accuracy of solution chains due
to the challenges in designing a reliable metric
for this purpose.
• GSM-P LUS focuses on evaluating the robustness of LLMs in solving math word problems
under various perturbations but does not investigate the underlying reasons behind the
failures of solving problems.

its impact is limited in terms of both performance
and robustness. It is crucial to acknowledge that
most LLMs, particularly for open-source models,
still fall significantly short of human performance,
particularly in math domains where even small errors can lead to task failure. Overall, GSM-P LUS
aims to facilitate detailed evaluation and understanding of LLMs on math reasoning. Dataset and
evaluation suits will be released.

We consider closed-source foundation models, i.e., GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) and GPT-3.5Turbo (OpenAI, 2022), open-source foundation

models, i.e., Mistral (Jiang et al., 2023), LLaMA2 (Touvron et al., 2023b), and CodeLlama (Roziere
et al., 2023), as well as open-source SFT models specifically designed for math reasoning, i.e.,
MetaMath (Yu et al., 2023a), Abel (Chern et al.,
2023), ToRA (Gou et al., 2023), MAmmoTH (Yue
et al., 2023), and SEGO (Zhao et al., 2023). The
decoding temperature is set to 0 for deterministic
predictions. Open-source base models are inferred
using 8 demonstrations. Our results on the GSM8K
of the listed LLMs match their previously reported
accuracy. We also establish a human performance
baseline by engaging qualified human annotators
who have successfully passed a qualification exam.
All annotators possess at least a bachelor’s degree.
Further details can be found in Appendix C.1.

We consider the final sentence of the math problem as the “queried answer”. If the model’s selfverification process yields a response of “No”,
C OMP proceeds with subgoal generation for the
subsequent thoughts (Prompt C.11). However, if
the responses include the phrase “So the answer
is”, C OMP terminates the iteration and arrives at
the final answer.
